parameters.solver: OpenFOAM v2512 simpleFoam bounded steady SST RANS; optional short pimpleFoam SST URANS check
parameters.symmetry: Y=0 half aircraft; integrals doubled for full-airframe dimensional forces; Aref half for force coefficients
parameters.propellers: Blades omitted; stationary cruise-oriented nacelles/booms/hubs retained. No propulsion model.
parameters.geometry_cleaning: 25 mm voxel union with two smoothing passes; thin trailing edges rounded
parameters.purpose: Initial airframe pressure/drag and separated-flow screening, not OEM performance, stall or certification
parameters.near_wall_strategy: Wall-function RANS on surface-refined snapped cells. No prism layers; boundary-layer profiles and skin-friction accuracy unresolved. Actual yPlus audited.
expected_outputs: native Intel case fields and logs
parameters.mesh_improvements: Refined near field and high-angle wake; wing/tail/nacelle level 7 surfaces; no prism layers; 15 tiny fluid cells closed. Configured checks pass; expanded concave-cell diagnostic remains.
parameters.geometry_scope: Same public-source approximation, half-domain Y symmetry. No propulsion. No grid independence or OEM stall/flight-limit validation.
parameters.mesh_attempt: Finer wing/tail/nacelle surface cells, no prism-layer extrusion; rejected layered and cell-splitting attempts retained
parameters.spatial_convection: bounded Gauss limitedLinearV 1 after 200 upwind conditioning steps

qualification: Independent public-reference geometry, generic airfoils, unpowered half-domain with enforced symmetry. No OEM validation or grid/timestep independence. Mesh audit and case numerical criteria are disclosed separately. These results cannot establish the real aircraft stall angle or safe operating limits.
statistics: Steady cases: last 200 solver-iteration means/ranges. URANS cases: physical-time-weighted means/ranges beginning at 0.03 s. Surface fields follow the documented basis per case.
force_arrows: Integrated wind-axis forces, illustrative common anchor, not CG or center of pressure.

maximum_sampled_lift.interpretation: Maximum among sampled reconstructed-model cases only; not a validated stall angle. Numerical and model limitations apply.
